source: Actual packaged extension (hosted build): the popup page at its 360×600 popup size, the badge on a neutral fictional sample cart in an 880×800 window, the onboarding consent screen; four sample cards.
namedStore: Lidl (lidl-us, served the sample cart at https://www.lidl.com/cart)
network: Page traffic blocked except the two in-memory sample carts; the catalog origin https://ai-checkout-api.onrender.com resolved to 127.0.0.1, so no refresh or usage report left the machine; "Not now" chosen on the consent screen.
amountsAre: Conditional estimates using sample inputs, not customer savings or earned rewards.

frames.name: consent
frames.text:
Welcome to AI Checkout

The best card you already own, shown right on your cart.

Help improve AI Checkout

Share usage reports so the reader, the store list and the recommendations get better. The extension works the same either way.

What is sent, after you choose Share
How you use it: the badge shown, expanded or dismissed, the popup opened and what its read found, a site switched off, when card terms were refreshed, and how far an amount you typed was from the one read (a rough range, not the amount).
Each recommendation: the recommended card, how many cards you have, the store’s category (for example groceries), whether the store is one AI Checkout recognises, whether it was a cart or checkout page, and the exact cart amount read or that it was not read.
The cards you picked, as catalog names (never card numbers, last four digits or balances).
Error codes, without messages or page content.
A random identifier, so repeated reports can be told apart: no name, email or browsing history. Each report also carries the versions of the extension, card terms and store list, and the month you chose Share.

No store name, web address or page text is sent with these reports. A store’s domain (for example example.com) is sent only when you tap “Suggest this store” or “Report a problem”, and those work whether you share or not.

Reports are kept for 90 days. You can stop sharing or delete your reports any time from Settings in the AI Checkout toolbar button. Privacy policy
